title: Immunohistochemistry for Mitochondrial Marker
author: Jennifer Rutkowsky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56ng9de
materials: Coverslip mounted with Prolong gold antifade reagent.

steps.title: Fix or Prepare Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Prepare tissue sections based on the embedding method used.

substeps.instruction: For frozen tissue sections (10μM) embedded in OCT: fix in 4% paraformaldehyde for 5 minutes.
For paraffin embedded sections: deparaffinize through three 100% xylene washes for 3 minutes each.
Rehydrate paraffin sections through 100%, 95%, 70%, 50%, and 30% ethanol, then into deionized water (3 minutes each).
Unmask antigens by steaming in Sodium citrate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash Sections
steps.instruction: Wash the sections three times for 10 minutes each in PBS.

steps.title: Block and Permeabilize
steps.instruction: Block and permeabilize the sections using Block/Perm Solution for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with anti-mitochondria antibody [MTC02] diluted 1:500 in Block/Perm overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Wash After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the sections three times in Block/Perm for 10 minutes each.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in goat anti-mouse IgG Alexa 555 (1:750) for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Washing
steps.instruction: Perform final washes to remove unbound antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Wash three times in Block/Perm and briefly in PBS.
Wash three times with PBS for 10 minutes each wash.
